description: This PHP source file defines a web page for Step 1 of a Home Network Wizard, providing a form for changing the admin/password credentials with validation and client-side scripting.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the current logged-in user.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the configuration data to the server via AJAX to set the new password, handles response to proceed or show error.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password change conditions and initiates the configuration update process.
